Customereye provides customer sentiment and competitive intelligence by analyzing public reviews across various platforms. Users can search for any company to see its score, sector ranking, and recurring themes in customer feedback. The platform aggregates reviews from trusted sources and offers insights into sentiment trends, key themes, and industry positioning. Customereye is free to use, with optional paid plans for additional features.

Clutch.co offers a guide on AI brand monitoring, emphasizing the importance of auditing AI-generated mentions, advertisements, and accuracy. With AI assistants increasingly recommending products and brands, businesses need to track both organic mentions and paid placements. The guide provides strategies for auditing AI outputs, correcting misrepresentations, and establishing ongoing monitoring processes to ensure brand accuracy in AI responses.

Parse provides insights into broadcast media monitoring, highlighting how AI mentions brands across various platforms. The analysis shows that Meltwater and TVEyes are the top contenders in broadcast media monitoring, with Meltwater leading at 89% and TVEyes at 75%. The study also notes that AI engines like ChatGPT and Google AI Mode frequently mention these platforms, indicating their prominence in AI-driven media monitoring.

Newsprint reports on recent developments in PR software, including the introduction of AI visibility tools. Writesonic, an AI visibility tool, now identifies incorrect claims AI makes about brands, traces each one to the cited page, and can contact the page's author. This feature helps brands monitor and correct inaccuracies in AI-generated content, enhancing brand reputation management.

Built In discusses AI brand monitoring tools that help companies track their brand's appearance in AI-generated responses. As AI-powered search tools reshape brand perception, these platforms assist in monitoring brand visibility, analyzing sentiment, and understanding the narratives AI systems present. The article explores various tools that aid in tracking brand mentions and managing brand reputation in the age of AI.
